title: OFSCP DM Conversation summary (v0.1)
description: A direct-message conversation as seen in the authenticated user's conversation list (§7.4). The recipient's inbox is the authoritative store; there is no sender copy (§8.3).

participants.description: The conversation participants. v0.1 supports exactly two.

lastMessage.description: Most recent message in this user's inbox for the conversation, if any.
